artifact_search_note: Expected FRANK_ARCHITECTURE.claycode.json path and connector search did not locate a current artifact; current FRANK baseline and owner-fixed directives were used provisionally without fabricating the missing artifact.

items.frank_statement: Model output and semantic effect intent must remain distinct from execution authority; effects cross an external capability/commit gateway.
items.counterhypothesis: Ambient host/FFI authority is simpler and explicit Clay capability tokens are unnecessary.
items.falsifier: A compiled ClayCode component can safely and audibly obtain all required effects with no explicit capability/host-binding contract while still preventing unauthorized equivalent effects and preserving replay/rollback evidence.
independent_checks: WebAssembly Component Model/WIT defines typed imports/exports and host/component resources but does not itself turn a textual interface name into ambient execution authority.
Current external component/resource architecture therefore provides an independent implementation analogue for keeping semantic intent separate from host-granted effect access.
adversarial_checks: Treat a WIT resource handle or imported function name as authority and test whether forged/named resources could bypass the Clay capability gateway.
items.reason: Independent host-interface architecture is compatible with and strengthens the separation, while not proving Clay's exact token algebra.
items.claycode_action: Keep CapabilityToken/EffectIntent/commit gateway semantics. Treat WIT/FFI resources as transport/resource identities, never authority by naming alone.

items.frank_statement: State/replay/version and order-sensitive semantics must remain explicit and deterministically identifiable.
items.counterhypothesis: One globally order-insensitive canonicalization is sufficient and simpler for ClayCode semantic identity.
items.falsifier: A globally order-insensitive canonicalizer preserves execution, replay and transaction semantics across ordered ClayCode programs and graph/transaction fixtures.
independent_checks: Local 20,000-case mutation experiment showed every tested ordered-operation swap changed execution while a deliberately over-normalizing hash collided in every case.
RFC 8785 canonicalization preserves JSON array element order rather than reordering arrays.
adversarial_checks: Sort/deduplicate ordered operation sequences and compare execution plus semantic hashes.
items.reason: Deterministic identity is required, but canonicalization must be type-directed: set-like collections may normalize ordering/duplicates; Ordered sequences must preserve order.
items.claycode_action: Freeze semantic_hash as type-directed canonical meaning and contract_hash as exact provenance-bound instance; never recursively sort all sequences.

items.frank_statement: ClayCode BASE must express the adaptive Micro Visual Classifier state/update/replay contract.
items.counterhypothesis: The requirement forces new dedicated ClayCode syntax or a special learner primitive.
items.falsifier: A frozen H1 adaptive learner fixture cannot be represented and replayed with ordinary ClayCode records, provenance/version fields, transactions, confidence/open-set values, budgets and rollback without an opaque semantic escape hatch.
independent_checks: Current G9 records, Delta, provenance, state/transaction and effect constructs appear structurally sufficient for the required state machine.
No executable counterexample in this run demonstrated a need for learner-specific syntax.
adversarial_checks: Attempt to encode candidate/current classifier version, trusted-example tier, open-set result, budget state and atomic promotion/rollback as ordinary typed state; reserve a language change only for a concrete failure.
items.reason: The representability requirement stands, but it should currently be satisfied through general-purpose types/runtime rather than a new special-purpose language primitive.
items.claycode_action: Add executable learner-state fixtures to parser/type/effect/evaluator tests; do not expand the semantic core unless H1 parity produces a counterexample.
